scene: A pneumatic tube drops glowing envelopes onto the rumbling mail train floor.
beats: You unfold the note inside, which glows like neon script warning about runaway umbrellas. The train screeches into the cavernous depot, and you hop onto the platform.
You flick misplaced letters into the pigeon's copper hopper, earning a brass receipt token. With a hiss of brakes, the doors open inside the towering depot.
You twist the valve; a puff of violet steam propels the train smoothly to the depot bumpers, letting you step out beneath shelves of forgotten hats.
picture: Side-scrolling interior of a rattling train carriage. On the far left, a purple envelope sits on the floor beneath a pneumatic glass chute. Centre-left, the player stands in an orange jacket. In the centre, a mechanical pigeon perches beside a canvas sorter bag. On the far right, a hissing brass pipe valve glows overhead.
